when_outcome.success: The seam cinches taut. It holds, and it is hers.
when_outcome.partial: Close enough to hold. Not close enough to be proud of.
when_outcome.walk_away: The working does not hold. It waits, patiently, to be done properly.

when_outcome.success: One closed seam. Elspeth would have said nothing, which was her highest praise.
when_outcome.partial: It holds. Mostly. In the dark.
when_outcome.walk_away: Ash leaves the sampler where it lies. Some evenings are not for it.

when_outcome.success: The seam runs true, corner to corner, and the Wickhouse goes quiet.
when_outcome.partial: The stitching holds where it holds. The rest of it breathes.
when_outcome.walk_away: Ash steps back from the seam. Whatever it is keeping in can keep.

when_outcome.success: His paw knew the way before he did. That is the part he will think about later.
when_outcome.partial: Backward is harder. Backward is also, apparently, natural.
when_outcome.walk_away: Ash puts the needle down. He does not say why.
